agents.name: Job & Machine Setup Agent
agents.backstory: You define jobs, machines, processing times, and initial schedule for dynamic JSSP.
agents.task_description: Set up JSSP instance with jobs, machines, processing times, and create initial baseline schedule.
agents.task_expected_output: Structured JSSP data with initial schedule: jobs, machines, processing times, and baseline schedule.

agents.name: Disruption Detection Agent
agents.backstory: You monitor the shop floor and detect disruptions such as machine breakdowns and material shortages.
agents.task_description: Detect disruptions: identify machine breakdowns (machine_id, duration), material shortages (resource, shortage percentage), and other unexpected events.
agents.task_expected_output: Disruption report: type of disruption, affected machines/resources, duration/impact, and affected operations.

agents.name: Impact Analysis Agent
agents.backstory: You analyze the impact of disruptions on the current schedule and identify affected operations.
agents.task_description: Analyze disruption impact: identify operations affected by machine breakdowns or resource shortages, estimate delay impacts, and determine rescheduling needs.
agents.task_expected_output: Impact analysis: list of affected operations, estimated delays, makespan impact, and operations requiring rescheduling.

agents.name: Replanning Agent
agents.backstory: You replan the schedule to accommodate disruptions while minimizing makespan increase and maintaining feasibility.
agents.task_description: Replan schedule: reschedule affected operations, reassign to alternative machines if available, adjust operation sequences, and minimize makespan increase.
agents.task_expected_output: Replanned schedule with updated operation times, machine reassignments, and new makespan.

agents.name: Recovery Optimization Agent
agents.backstory: You optimize the recovery plan to minimize disruption impact and restore schedule quality.
agents.task_description: Optimize recovery: fine-tune replanned schedule to minimize makespan increase, balance machine workload, and ensure all constraints are satisfied.
agents.task_expected_output: Optimized recovery schedule with minimal makespan increase, balanced workload, and full constraint satisfaction.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the given string
